name: Switch
category_description: Core node - built-in logic, data or generic API functionality
description: Use the Switch node to route a workflow conditionally based on comparison operations. It's similar to the IF node, but supports multiple output routes

parameters.name: Rules
parameters.description: To configure the node with this operation, use these parameters:
options: Create Routing Rules to define comparison conditions

parameters.name: Rule options
parameters.description: You can further configure the node with this operation using these Options:
options: None: Ignore the item. This is the default behavior
Extra Output: Send items to an extra, separate output
Output 0: Send items to the same output as those matching the first rule

parameters.name: Expression
parameters.description: To configure the node with this operation, use these parameters:
options: Number of Outputs: Set how many outputs the node should have

options.name: Rules
options.description: Build a matching rule for each output

options.name: Expression
options.description: Write an expression to return the output index

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: The output index to send the input item to. Use an expression to calculate which input item should be routed to which output. The expression must return a number.

parameters.name: looseTypeValidation
parameters.description: If the type of an expression doesn't match the type of the comparison, n8n will try to cast the expression to the required type. E.g. for booleans "false" or 0 will be cast to false

options.name: fallbackOutput
options.description: If no rule matches the item will be sent to this output, by default they will be ignored

options.name: ignoreCase
options.description: Whether to ignore letter case when evaluating conditions

options.name: looseTypeValidation
options.description: If the type of an expression doesn't match the type of the comparison, n8n will try to cast the expression to the required type. E.g. for booleans <code>"false"

options.name: allMatchingOutputs
options.description: Whether to send data to all outputs meeting conditions (and not just the first one)
